name: Sonae, SGPS, S.A.
summary: Sonae, SGPS, S.A. operates a portfolio of businesses in retail, real estate, telecommunications, technology, and financial services in Portugal and internationally. The company operates through six segments: MC, Worten, Musti, Sierra, Bright Pixel, and NOS. It is involved in retailing in the food sector through a network of stores, such as Continente Modelo and Continente Bom Dia supermarkets, Continente hypermarkets, and Meu Super, a franchised supermarket; health and wellness markets under the Wells, Arenal, Druni, and other retail banners; bookshops and stationery under the Note! brand; and cafeterias and restaurants under the Bagga brand.
